utterances.text: Hello there! How was your day?
Hi Grandpa! My day was pretty good, thanks for asking. How about yours?
Oh no, that sounds serious. Do you need help getting it fixed?
Oh, I think there might be a misunderstanding. My day was good, nothing serious happened. But thanks for offering to help!
It sounds like you're having a tough time with the car. Do you want me to come over and help?
Oh no, Grandpa, there's no issue with the car. Everything's fine, really! But I appreciate your willingness to help.
I'm sorry if I made you feel that way. I just wanted to make sure you're safe.
No need to apologize, Grandpa! I know you're just looking out for me, and I really appreciate it.
Alright, I'll let you handle it. Just let me know if you need anything.
Thanks, Grandpa! I'll definitely let you know if I need anything. You're the best!
The gas pedal is on the right, just press it gently.
Got it, Grandpa! I'll be careful. Thanks for the tip!
It's alright, everyone makes mistakes. Just take your time and try again.
Thanks, Grandpa. I really appreciate your patience with me.
Yes, just keep going around and you'll get the hang of it. I'm here if you need any help.
I'll keep practicing, Grandpa. Thanks for being so supportive!
Great job! You're getting the hang of it. Keep practicing and you'll be a pro in no time.
Thanks, Grandpa! I'll keep at it and hopefully get better soon.
Haha, just like in the movies! You're doing great, keep it up.
Haha, thanks! I hope I can be as good as you one day.
Take a deep breath, you're doing fine. Just go slow and steady, and you'll get it right.
Thanks for the encouragement, Grandpa. I'll keep practicing and take it slow.
